sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
sources.evidence: March 17, 2026 announcement explicitly releases nano in the API. The nano column reports reasoning, tool-calling and vision benchmarks. It describes classification, extraction, ranking and simple coding tasks, but gives no numerical model size. Mini product availability and computer-use support are not transferred to nano.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 nano API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact model document lists March 17 default snapshot, 400,000 context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning tokens and none/low/medium/high/xhigh effort. It explicitly lists function calling, prompt caching, Chat Completions and Responses; status is deprecated.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: March 17 entry explicitly releases gpt-5.4-nano to Chat Completions and Responses. Nano supports compaction but lacks the built-in tool-search and computer-use tools supported by mini.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: October 1, 2026 notice explicitly schedules shutdown of gpt-5.4-nano and gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17 for April 1, 2027. This date remains future at review.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived guide explicitly applies before GPT-5.6 and explains prompt caching through Transformer attention key/value projections. Combined with the exact nano caching feature, it supports a qualified broad Transformer classification, not complete block topology or counts.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses processes PDFs for vision-capable models by extracting text and page images; Chat Completions also accepts PDFs. With exact nano vision and endpoint support, PDF is an API document format rather than a separate native modality.

sources.title: Public Summary of Training Content for GPT-5.4 nano
sources.evidence: July 31, 2026 summary specifically identifies nano and says it is not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model. Training token/image/audio/video quantities are not model parameters or API modalities. It lists Union-market placement March 12, which differs from the explicit March 17 public/API launch. No neural topology or total/active parameter count is disclosed.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card
sources.evidence: The announcement-linked card includes a March 17 appendix for mini. Searching the complete extracted PDF found no nano entry or parameter disclosure for nano; neither the full model nor mini specifications are substituted for it.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card was checked for exact nano comparison evidence. The complete extracted document has no nano entry; full GPT-5.4 comparisons do not establish this variant size or architecture.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card was checked for exact nano comparison evidence. The complete extracted PDF contains NanoGPT evaluation references, but no GPT-5.4 nano entry or production parameter disclosure; NanoGPT benchmark training sizes are unrelated.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service access and reserve service IP. This supports descriptive proprietary hosted-model licensing, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: Lists GPT-5.4 nano as a deprecated hosted model and separately lists gpt-oss-120b/20b as Apache-licensed open-weight models. No downloadable nano weights are offered by the checked release or model pages.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-5.4 nano record
sources.evidence: Catalog lead was read and used to locate exact primary benchmarks and verify its initial assertions; it is not treated as independent proof.

name.note: Retain the developer’s exact display name and capitalization.

developer.note: Both the launch and exact-model training summary identify OpenAI.

family.note: Normalize the stated generation; this does not assert shared weights with mini or the full model.

release_date.note: Explicit public/API launch is March 17. The later training summary lists Union-market placement March 12; retain the documented public launch and record the unresolved date/scope discrepancy instead of silently treating regulatory placement as a public release.

open_weights.note: Released as a hosted API model; no downloadable nano weights identified in the checked primary release and inventory.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service licensing classification, not an SPDX or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total production parameter count in the exact launch, model document or later exact-model training summary. Later cards were searched for exact nano columns and had none. Targeted first-party parameter, training and interpretability searches found no numerical disclosure; training-data quantities and sibling specifications are excluded.

active_parameters_b.note: No active production parameter count or activation topology in the checked exact-model sources or later disclosure searches. Do not equate total and active counts or infer dense/MoE execution.

architecture.note: Qualified cross-source inference: exact nano documentation explicitly enables prompt caching and OpenAI’s pre-GPT-5.6 technical account describes Transformer attention KV state. This is a broad Transformer-based classification only; complete block structure, dense/MoE layout and layer counts remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Exact total context is 400,000 tokens, separately from the explicit 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. Documentation does not establish live endpoint operation.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output. PDF is an API format processed into text and page images. Audio/video training sources in the public summary do not establish API audio/video support; hosted image-generation tools are not native model output.

reasoning.note: Exact nano API document lists reasoning tokens and none, low, medium, high and xhigh efforts; none as the default does not remove reasoning capability.

tool_call.note: Exact model supports function calling. Built-in computer use and tool search are explicitly unsupported; general tool support does not imply those two tools.

patch.description: GPT-5.4 model for classification, data extraction and ranking, with text and image input.

sources.label: Public Summary of Training Content for GPT-5.4 nano

patch.notes: Public API launch and default snapshot are March 17, 2026. A July training summary separately lists Union-market placement March 12; this unresolved date/scope discrepancy does not override the explicit public launch. Context is 400,000 tokens, with 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. PDF denotes API extraction into text and page images, not native PDF processing. Transformer is a qualified broad inference from exact-model prompt caching and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 KV documentation; detailed topology and total/active counts remain undisclosed in the checked sources. Deprecated October 1, 2026, with API shutdown scheduled April 1, 2027; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Confirmed March 17 public release, 400K total context, exact dated snapshot, reasoning and function calling. Normalize gpt-5.4 family, add proprietary licensing, API PDF format and qualified broad Transformer classification, and replace promotional description. Exact-model July training summary discloses no parameter counts and introduces a March 12 Union-market date discrepancy, recorded explicitly. April 1, 2027 API shutdown is scheduled, not past.
